description: Found by defk-t11.4: defk-juw's lost-resume check (F->resume cleared on arrival at the safepoint's loop) misses (1) a wrong dispatch case that jumps to another loop's label: it still clears F->resume, so the kernel silently gives a wrong answer; (2) nested loops where the top-level case is missing: the inner loop's dispatch still finds and clears the resume after the outer loop restarted. Consider clearing only when the arrived-at safepoint id equals F->resume (compare ids, not just clear), keeping zero loop cost. Done when the t11.4 mutation harness (test/resume_test.exs lost_mutant/2) has a wrong-label and a nested-missing case that both raise.
title: Resume check can't catch a dispatch to the wrong loop
